name: narcissu: Himeko's Epilogue
original_name: ナルキッソス 姫子エピローグ
source:
After the final drive with Setsumi, 
Himeko has once again returned to the 7th floor. 

Himeko has but a single regret. -- Her best friend Yuka. 

Only Himeko knew about Yuka's timid and unreliable personality. 

There is little time left. Her life will run out in one month. 

In that time, there is something Himeko wants to do for her "best friend" ...

[From[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/narcissu-10th-anniversary-anthology-project] Kickstarter campaign[/url]]
translation:
与濑津美最后一次开车后，姬子再次回到了七楼。

姬子只有一个遗憾——她最好的朋友优香。

只有姬子知道优香胆小而不可靠的性格。

时间所剩无几。她的生命将在一个月后结束。

在这段时间里，姬子想为自己的“挚友”做一件事……

[来源于[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/narcissu-10th-anniversary-anthology-project]Kickstarter众筹页面[/url]]
